about: v0.5b Kathā story lines (OWNER: WP-A): the new lines inside { "if": "style.katha", "then": [...] } blocks of chapters 1–3 (and story-common) that were not already in sa-dialogue-5.json at v0.5a, and the new Kathā-only speaker titles there ("label": true). Same format and rules as files 1–5 (notes/sambhashana.md); en and ctx are generated by collectStoryStrings() (file 6), fill sa only.

entries.en: Say the first quarter with me, {player}.
In mid-stream Sita bows to the Ganga and prays.
entries.sa: नद्याः मध्ये सीता गङ्गां नमस्कृत्य वदति।

entries.en: Mother Ganga, guard Rama. Fourteen years we will live in the forest. Bring us home again, and I will worship you.
entries.sa: हे गङ्गे मातः, रामं रक्ष। वयं चतुर्दश वर्षाणि वने वत्स्यामः। ततः अस्मान् पुनः गृहं नय। तदा अहं त्वां पूजयिष्यामि।

entries.en: Struck by Rama's arrow, the deer falls. There lies Maricha, in his true form.
entries.sa: रामस्य बाणेन मृगः पतति। सः मृगः न, सः मारीचः एव।

entries.en: Then Maricha dies. But his cry, in Rama's own voice, rings on through the forest.
entries.sa: ततः मारीचः प्राणान् त्यजति। परन्तु तस्य शब्दः वने सर्वत्र गच्छति। सः शब्दः रामस्य शब्दः इव।

entries.en: Jatayu has breath for only a few words. What will you ask him?
entries.sa: जटायोः प्राणाः अल्पाः। त्वं किं पृच्छसि?

entries.en: Which way did he take her?
Ravana. The king of the rakshasas.
Through the sky... to the south.
Jatayu only gasps. His breath is almost gone.
entries.sa: जटायुः किम् अपि न वदति। तस्य प्राणाः अल्पाः।
